signature: SUBROUTINE ZGTTS2( ITRANS, N, NRHS, DL, D, DU, DU2, IPIV, B, LDB )

params.name: itrans
params.reference:
Specifies the form of the system of equations.

-   `= 0`: $A \, X = B$     (No transpose)
-   `= 1`: $A^T \, X = B$  (Transpose)
-   `= 2`: $A^H \, X = B$  (Conjugate transpose)

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A.

params.name: nrhs
params.reference: The number of right hand sides, i.e., the number of columns of the matrix B. $\mathrm{NRHS} \ge 0$.

params.name: DL
params.reference: The (n-1) multipliers that define the matrix L from the LU factorization of A.

params.name: d
params.reference: The n diagonal elements of the upper triangular matrix U from the LU factorization of A.

params.name: DU
params.reference: The (n-1) elements of the first super-diagonal of U.

params.name: DU2
params.reference: The (n-2) elements of the second super-diagonal of U.

params.name: IPIV
params.reference: The pivot indices; for $1 \le i \le n$, row i of the matrix was interchanged with row `IPIV(i)`. `IPIV(i)` will always be either i or i+1; `IPIV(i) = i` indicates a row interchange was not required.

params.name: B
params.reference: On entry, the matrix of right hand side vectors B. On exit, B is overwritten by the solution vectors X.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,N)$.
